plugins.name: threat-model-suite
plugins.description: Threat modeling, privacy, and compliance skills + specialist agents, with a deterministic manifest-validation hard gate (PreToolUse hook) that blocks report generation until the emitted manifests pass the structural + consistency contract. Ships an offline diagram render toolchain (Mermaid + D2): the render/preflight scripts (skills/threat-model/scripts/) and the vendored typed-icon set (skills/threat-model/references/icons/, MDI Apache-2.0). Renderer binaries (d2, rsvg-convert/resvg, mermaid-cli) are not committed — installed per-OS and enforced by a fail-loud preflight (ensure_renderer.sh); see plugin.json renderToolchain for pins + install.
